actionConfiguration.body: SELECT p2.*, p1.par001_desc, p2.par002_atencao AS severidade FROM "{{JSutils.currentSchema()}}".hotpar002 p2 INNER JOIN "{{JSutils.currentSchema()}}".hotpar001 p1 ON p1.par001_id = p2.par002_par001_id WHERE p2.par002_deleted <> true AND p2.par002_ani002_id = {{ appsmith.store.petID_Reserva }} AND p2.par002_atencao = true ORDER BY p1.par001_desc ASC;
